is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l., Anopheles funestus, and Anopheles pharoensis.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports phenotypic insecticide susceptibility and synergist bioassays but does not genotype any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (RR/RS/SS counts or allele frequencies) are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Gondar zuria district, Ethiopia.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Gondar zuria district, Northwest Ethiopia.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from March 1, 2022, to August 31, 2022.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study appears to be a routine new collection.

supplement.evidence: No genotype data are reported in the paper or supplementary materials.

assessment.summary: This study assessed the phenotypic insecticide susceptibility of Anopheles mosquitoes in Gondar zuria district, Ethiopia, using WHO tube tests and synergist bioassays with PBO. It did not perform any molecular genotyping of resistance markers.
